headline: Adelaide Hills Residents Protest Proposed AI Data Centre Construction
summary: Community members and opposition political parties staged protests against a proposed AI data centre in Adelaide Hills, with locals pledging legal action to block the planning application.
why: The expansion of AI infrastructure is encountering local planning and environmental resistance globally over grid power usage, water demands, and land zoning.

impacts.name: Data Center Infrastructure
impacts.why: Local opposition and legal challenges threaten approval of the planned AI data facility.
